card.name: Forms of the verb invest
card.fires_on: The word invest and its forms (invested, investing, reinvested) in general web text, usually just before the word in. It covers money, time and effort being put into something.

modes.label: Spending money or gear
modes.description: Advice to invest in a product such as shoes, a chair or a bed.
modes.example: consider<< investing>> in an ergonomically designed work chair

modes.label: Time, effort or commitment
modes.description: Invested used for time, practice or personal stake in a cause.
modes.example: much time has to be<< invested>> in

modes.label: Organizational funding
modes.description: Countries or companies investing in capital, technology or research.
modes.example: and<< investing>> in research and development of carbon seque

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It lights up on the word invest in any form, such as invested or investing, usually just before "in".
